notes: The parts list is for G0077150 (49ST/CSA). The battery is included with the unit.

gaps: Neither document names the other's number.
The spec sheet is tied to G0077150 only because Generac serves it under that variant's manual path.

Conflict: the parts manual lists the battery as part A0006353770 (sealed, 12 V 9 Ah) while the spec sheet gives battery part no. 0G9449 (lead acid, 12 V DC, 9 Ah); only the parts-manual number is on the part.
The spec sheet gives fuel tank capacity 7.9 gal and calls the tank steel; the parts manual lists a 7.92 gal tank kit.
These unit ratings are not attached to any part, since the spec sheet names no parts.
method: Two Generac documents, both read as text on 2026-11-12: the GP8000E 49ST/CSA parts manual for G0077150 (part no. A0001042562 rev. B; unit, control-panel and engine parts lists with Generac part numbers and quantities) and the GP8000E spec sheet for model 7715-1 (49ST/CSA), document A0001025747 rev.
The parts list has a brush-type alternator and an AVR.
The alternator's 8000 W, from its parts-list name, equals the spec sheet's AC rated running watts (maximum starting watts are 10000).
The spec sheet gives unit ratings: 8000 running W, 10000 starting W, 120/240 VAC 60 Hz, 66.6 / 33.3 A, 420cc OHV engine at 3600 rpm, AVR yes, electric and recoil start.
